annotations.title: Request a conscience check (is this OK?)

description: Request a human judgment on whether a planned action, message or decision is fair, decent and appropriate for the people affected – before an agent acts. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

affected.description: Who is affected and in what situation.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

concerns.description: Optional: what you are unsure about.

panel.description: True for a panel of 5 instead of one human.

planned_action.description: What the agent plans to do or send.
